The proposed improvements are a part of the Street Improvement Plans for the new Flower Mart development at 901 16th Street
items.text: Approving the implementation of transportation improvements, including upgrading Class II bike lanes to Class IV protected bikeways on Mississippi Street from 16th Street to 17th Street, a key connection in the citywide protected bikeway network. The proposed improvements are a part of the Street Improvement Plans for the new Flower Mart development at 901 16th Street: (Explanatory documents include a staff report and resolution.) A. ESTABLISH – CLASS IV BIKEWAY (PROTECTED BIKEWAY) – Mississippi Street, northbound, east side, from 17th Street to 16th Street Mississippi Street, southbound, west side, from 16th Street to 17th Street. B. ESTABLISH – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING ANY TIME – Mississippi Street, east side, from 17th Street to 16th Street Mississippi Street, west side, from 16th Street to 17th Street. C. ESTABLISH – TOW-AWAY NO PARKING, PERMITTED COMMUTER SHUTTLE BUS ZONE, 6 AM TO 10 AM, AND 4 PM TO 8 PM, MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY – Mississippi Street, east side, from 17th Street to 73 feet southerly (73-foot white zone). Item 10.2 was removed from the Consent Calendar and heard with Item 11. RESOLUTION No. 240305-017
